name: KEI Industries Ltd
title: KEI Industries Ltd - 517569 - Transcript Of Analysts/Investors Call Pertaining To The Audited Financial Results For The Quarter And Year Ended On March 31, 2026.

read.thesis: Capacity-led volume ramp: FY27 volume guided +17-18% from Sanand and Chinchpada, with Q4 volume only ~2% due to capacity constraint and Sanand delayed six months.

utilisation.quote: All our cable plants of Rajasthan were operating at peak capacity during last financial year '24-'25 itself

capex.quote: every year, we will be doing around INR600 crores to INR700 crores capital expenditure for next 2 to 3 years continuous.

triggers.label: Sanand Phase 1 commissioned Dec-25
triggers.quote: So we commissioned the first phase in the December '25. And second and last phase is expected to be commissioned in the fourth quarter of FY26, '27.

triggers.label: Q4 volume growth ~2% (capacity constrained)
triggers.quote: Volume growth for the quarter was close to 2%. And the full year basis, the net volume growth is, I'd said, 6.2%.

triggers.label: FY27 volume +17-18%
triggers.quote: We are expecting 17% to 18% volume growth in this current financial year, which will mainly coming from Sanand new facility.

triggers.label: Pass-through on institutional orders
triggers.quote: In all the institutional orders, it gets passed on.

guidance.quote: We are expecting 17% to 18% volume growth in this current financial year
This year, in EHV segment, we expect a growth of around 20%
every year, we will be doing around INR600 crores to INR700 crores capital expenditure
taking our export to around approximately 20% of our total sales in the current financial year

red_flags.label: Receivable and creditor swings; Q4 volume ~2%
red_flags.quote: Volume growth for the quarter was close to 2%.

evasions.topic: Q4 volume and price hike quantum
evasions.quote: Every day, we are quoting and every day, we are quoting on a prevailing market price.
Normally the size of the company, INR500 crores to INR600 crores cash will always be carried.
